issues.on_page: 2710 Regular pupil transportation 299,198; p6 General Fund Components combining schedule: Student transportation 309,042 with Reclassifications (100,000) -> Total 209,042; Depreciation Fund Transfers 150,000 / Reclassifications (150,000)
issues.issue: Transfer hidden inside a spending line. The General Fund schedule's spending lines include the 150,000 transfer to the Depreciation Fund ('as expensed from the General Fund', p14). The p6 Reclassifications column removes it from spending: (100,000) from Student transportation (lines 2710/2712/2713, so 2710 is the only line large enough) and a net 50,000 from Instruction/State/Federal programs (GF 7,014,111 + 10,799 + 7,637 + 280,177 = 7,312,724 vs Total Instruction 7,262,724). detail keeps the full 150,000 as expenditure and also records the Depreciation Fund 'Transfer - General Fund' +150,000 as other financing, so the same money is counted as both spending and a transfer. The rules require splitting the line (spending part plus a -100,000 other-financing item with split_from and review), and likewise for the 50,000 in the instruction/program lines.
